Based on my experience so far, I do not understand why this practice has such a high rating. In my opinion, the rating does not reflect the actual quality of care or organisation.

Today I attended an appointment and checked in at the door exactly as instructed. I waited for almost an hour. When I eventually approached reception to ask why I had not been called, I was told that I had missed my appointment because I had supposedly not checked in.
After I challenged this and some time passed, I was informed that the doctor had not noticed my check-in and therefore could no longer see me that day.

The reason I waited so long before approaching reception is simple: during my previous appointment at this practice, the doctor was running almost an hour late. At that time, reception confirmed that everything was fine. I therefore assumed the same situation was happening and did not want to interrupt staff unnecessarily. That assumption turned out to be a mistake.

I also want to point out that during the entire time I was waiting, no other patients were called in to see this doctor. For this reason, it is unclear why I could not be seen at all, even for a shorter appointment.

What makes this situation worse is that no one apologised. The situation was treated as normal.

I am writing this review as a warning to others: arriving on time and checking in as instructed does not guarantee that you will actually be seen. I strongly recommend going to reception to make sure the system has registered you Unfortunately, my experience has been very disappointing. I submitted a request for a routine, non-urgent appointment and, despite waiting three weeks, I have still not received any contact from the practice.

As someone who works clinically within a GP setting and is familiar with the EMIS operating system, I understand priority levels and did not expect a same-day or even a rapid appointment — a wait of up to a month would have been completely reasonable. What was not reasonable was the complete lack of communication and the dismissive attitude I encountered from the receptionist when I followed up.

It’s worth remembering that practices receive NHS funding per registered patient, so responsiveness and patient care should reflect that. Unfortunately, the lack of acknowledgement of my request has made it clear that this practice does not meet basic expectations for patient communication. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this surgery.
